title: SendMessage Metadata — Tier 2 (Partial)
description: Partial metadata for the SendMessage tool (inter-agent communication). Provenance is required. koth.outcome_signal reflects whether the message was delivered. decision links this communication to the active decision context.

notes.koth.outcome_signal: 'win' if message delivered, 'loss' if recipient not found or shutdown request rejected.
notes.koth.koth_domain: Domain of the coordination (e.g., 'planning' for task assignments, 'cross_cutting' for shutdown requests).
notes.provenance.caller_chain: Key field: shows the full agent chain, useful for tracing multi-hop message flows.
